name: agentmemory-architecture
title_zh: 拆开记忆引擎看存储与检索全链路，附端口与查看器
tagline_zh: 别只当黑盒用——想知道记忆到底存哪、怎么取回、如何扩展？这份架构说明把 iii 原语、存储模型。
tagline_en: Stop treating memory as a black box. This skill maps agentmemory's iii primitives, storage model, ports, and.
desc_en: How agentmemory is built, the iii engine primitives it runs on, its storage model, ports, and the viewer. Use when reasoning about how memory is stored or retrieved end to end, when extending the system, or when answering how agentmemory works under the hood.
why_zh: 它不泛泛讲概念，而是按端到端路径拆解：从写入到检索每一步落在哪个模块、哪个端口，让你改代码前先看清因果。
why_en: It traces the end-to-end write-to-retrieve path through concrete modules and ports—so you see the causal chain before touching.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 agentmemory 自身架构，不含 iii 引擎的安装配置；若你只是调用现成记忆接口而非扩展系统。
limit_en: Covers agentmemory's own architecture only—not iii setup. Useless if you just call existing memory APIs without extending the system.
title_en: See agentmemory's storage, retrieval, ports & viewer.
